name: Acceptance suite-3 test 78 - role modification without AssumeRole (regression)
note: IAM-1003 regression: the principal can grant permissions to and rewrite the trust of the role but has NO sts:AssumeRole leg. Without the assume prerequisite there is no complete self-assumption path, so no ROLE-TAKEOVER; the standalone high role-control/persistence capabilities (PUT-INLINE-POLICY + TRUST-POLICY-MODIFY) remain, because another principal or service could later use the modified role.
